Select: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name. Source: molecule_dictionary, drug_mechanism, target_dictionary, compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno, drug_mechanism to target_dictionary on tid, molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter: max_phase = 4 AND action_type = 'BLOCKER'. Sort: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
